title: Alaz system validation (inter-sensor agreement)
what_this_measures: Monthly MODIS hotspot counts vs a FIXED VIIRS filter (policy A) on the same ROI/months. Covered quiet (zero–zero) months are kept; months without product coverage are excluded. Platform scale, harm dampening (alpha), and blend weight are fit only on calibration months and scored on later test months.
what_this_does_not_measure: Independent fire/no-fire accuracy, burned-area skill, or event matching against perimeters / Sentinel-2 / Landsat / MCD64A1. VIIRS is another sensor, not ground truth. Harmonizer was trained on synthetic data. Monthly post-cal is a count-level correction, not proof of per-pixel skill.

fair_confidence_sensitivity.reference_name: VIIRS inter-sensor agreement reference (not ground truth)
fair_confidence_sensitivity.nrt_mix_note: ROI mixes Standard and NRT rows; prefer --standard-only for completed Standard months when claiming long-term comparison.

A.caveat: Metrics compare monthly MODIS series to a VIIRS comparison reference on the same ROI/months. Passing thresholds or lower RMSE does not scientifically validate harmonization; VIIRS is not ground truth.

B.caveat: Metrics compare monthly MODIS series to a VIIRS comparison reference on the same ROI/months. Passing thresholds or lower RMSE does not scientifically validate harmonization; VIIRS is not ground truth.

C.caveat: Metrics compare monthly MODIS series to a VIIRS comparison reference on the same ROI/months. Passing thresholds or lower RMSE does not scientifically validate harmonization; VIIRS is not ground truth.

fair_confidence_sensitivity.selection_rule: Month set locked from policy A + product coverage. MODIS threshold varies A/B/C while VIIRS filter stays at A. Covered zero–zero months kept; no-coverage months excluded (not treated as zero fire).
fair_confidence_sensitivity.scientific_claim: Lower RMSE here measures inter-sensor agreement with VIIRS, not independent detection accuracy. Harmonizer was trained on synthetic data. Do not present this as ground-truth validation.

verdict.note: Inter-sensor agreement only. Post-cal (alpha + cap + blend) is fit on calibration months only. Beating raw/baseline is necessary but not sufficient scientific validation.
